name: Sleep Cycle
description: Waking-summary continuity layer over openclaw's native session reset. The reset itself is openclaw's own scheduled session.reset (mode 'daily') — it archives the long-lived transcript and starts fresh with no cron, no tool, and no operator.admin scope (the prompt-cache cost fix, done the framework's way; seeded by the runtime entrypoint under session.resetByType.direct). This plugin rides that reset via a `before_reset` hook that captures the handoff tail + vector-ranks memories (one oasis-semantics embed burst, zero LLM) and a memory-prompt supplement that injects them into the fresh session. A `sleep_deep` tool is kept for MANUAL on-demand resets (e.g. relieving a rate limit mid-day). The dream step stays owned by memory-core's dreaming cron.

enabled.description: Master switch. Default true. Force-set from OASIS_SLEEP_ENABLED by the entrypoint.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the waking-summary morning gate + date bookkeeping. Default America/New_York.

dozeAt.description: Informational (HH:MM) — the wind-down anchor; the dream cron sits between this and deepSleepAt. Not consumed at runtime.

deepSleepAt.description: Informational (HH:MM). The actual deep-sleep time is the OASIS_SLEEP_DEEP-derived cron the entrypoint installs; keep them in sync.

wakeAt.description: Informational (HH:MM) — the morning boundary; the waking summary injects until `wakingSummary.injectUntilHour`.

sessionMatch.description: Substring filters selecting which session keys sleep_deep archives + resets. Default ["telegram:direct"].

memoryHits.description: How many vector-ranked memory chunks to stage for the fresh session. Default 5.

transcriptPointers.description: How many archived transcript paths to reference. Default 3.

injectUntilHour.description: Stop injecting the waking summary at/after this local hour (0-24). Default 24 = no clock cutoff; the 20h freshness window is the only gate, so an off-schedule (e.g. mid-day) deep sleep still injects its handoff. Lower it (e.g. 12) for a morning-only cutoff.

contextNap.description: Context-threshold deep-sleep. Fires the SAME archive+reset+waking-summary cycle as the nightly deep-sleep when a session's live prompt crosses a fraction of the ACTIVE model's context window — pre-empting native compaction. Continuity is preserved (archived transcript + waking handoff + memories); only the working window is refreshed. Driven off per-turn hooks (llm_output/message_sending/agent_end).

enabled.description: Master switch for the context-nap trigger. Default true. Force-set from OASIS_CONTEXT_NAP_ENABLED by the entrypoint.

thresholdRatio.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's context budget that triggers a nap. Default 0.85. Model-aware: a 32K fallback naps ~6x sooner than a 200K primary.

preemptTokens.description: Tokens reserved below the window before native compaction fires; the nap fires before this line so we reset instead of compacting. Keep = compaction.reserveTokensFloor + softThreshold (entrypoint default 5000 + 4000 = 9000).

guardTokens.description: Fire the nap this many tokens BEFORE the native compaction line (extra margin so the nap always wins the race). Default 1500.

minAbsoluteTokens.description: Never nap while the prompt is smaller than this (avoids noise on tiny-window models). Default 2000.

minMsBetweenNaps.description: Per-session debounce so a pinned-high context can't nap every turn. Default 60000 (60s).

message.description: Operator-visible notice appended to the tripping turn's reply. Default "Attention exhausted. Clean-up & refresh required. Taking a quick power nap..."

semanticsEndpoint.description: oasis-semantics sidecar endpoint used to embed + rank memory chunks. Default http://oasis-semantics:8732.

semanticsModel.description: Embedding model id passed to oasis-semantics. Default "default" (bge-small-en-v1.5) — MUST match the memory-core embedding tier.

memoryTidy.description: Nightly MEMORY.md tidy: moves whole sections VERBATIM into memory/archive/ (still searchable through memory_search) and leaves a one-line pointer, so MEMORY.md stays under openclaw's bootstrap budget. Moves only HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED sections, stale dreaming promotions, and sections with a stale date in the heading; never pinned (<!-- pin -->), identity, CURRENT or SUPERSEDES sections.

softCapChars.description: Tidy starts when MEMORY.md is larger than this. Default 16000 (openclaw truncates bootstrap files at 20000).

targetChars.description: Tidy stops once MEMORY.md is at or under this. Default 14000.

promotedMaxAgeDays.description: Move dreaming 'Promoted From Short-Term Memory (<date>)' blocks older than this. Default 14.

datedMaxAgeDays.description: Move sections whose heading carries a date older than this. Default 30.

dreamReportRetentionDays.description: Move memory/dreaming/<phase>/<date>.md reports older than this to archive/dreaming/ (outside the search index). 0 disables. Default 14.

dailyNoteRetentionDays.description: Move memory/<date>.md daily notes older than this to memory/archive/daily/ (still indexed). 0 disables. Default 30.

minHoursBetweenRuns.description: Minimum hours between tidy runs. Default 20.

enabled.description: Master switch for the nightly MEMORY.md tidy. Default true.
